item.title: Associate professor: BIOS-11/A PHARMACOLOGY (Univ. Catt. S.Cuore)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-02 16:00
Institution: Univ. Catt. S.Cuore, Roma
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-11 Farmacologia

The candidate should demonstrate teaching experience consistent with the BIOS-11/A Pharmacology scientific-disciplinary sector, gained within the single-cycle Master's Degree programs in Pharmacy and Medicine and Surgery, the Bachelor's Degree programs in health professions (both on- and off-campus), medical and non-medical post-graduate schools and university Master programs.the candidate will be required to conduct research and coordinate research within the priority research lines of the Pharmacology Section of the Department of Translational Medicine and Surgery, with particular reference to pharmacodynamic studies in the area of Neuroscience.
